# Datasance PoT Documentation

> Official docs for Datasance PoT platform train v3.8.0. Greenfield release: Edgelet nodes, EdgeOps Console, Controller with embedded OIDC, and containerized edge workloads.

## Platform summary (v3.8.0)

Datasance PoT (Platform of Things) is an enterprise open-source fog and distributed edge computing platform. You deploy a Control Plane on Kubernetes or remote hosts, connect **Edgelet nodes** at the edge, and run containerized microservices across heterogeneous hardware.

**v3.8.0 is a greenfield release.** There is no in-place upgrade from v3.7 field deployments. You need a new Controller database, **Edgelet v1.0.0+** on every node, and **potctl v3.8.0**. Legacy Java iofog-agent and v3.7 field agents are not supported on Controller v3.8.

The v3.8 web UI is **EdgeOps Console** (embedded in the Controller image). Authentication defaults to **embedded OIDC** in the Control Plane.

## Migration

- [Migrating to v3.8.0](https://docs.datasance.com/migrating-to-v3-8): Greenfield migration steps from v3.7 or v1.6.x field deployments.

## Version matrix (platform train v3.8.0)

| Component | Version |
| --------- | ------- |
| PoT platform | v3.8.0 |
| Controller | v3.8.0 |
| potctl | v3.8.0 |
| ioFog Operator | v3.8.0 |
| Router (wrapper image) | v3.8.0 |
| Edgelet | v1.0.0 |
| EdgeOps Console | v1.0.9 |
| ioFog Go SDK | v3.8.0 |

Full release notes: [What's New](https://docs.datasance.com/home/whats-new) (classic format published in Plan 12).

## apiVersion policy

The Controller accepts uploaded YAML with either `datasance.com/v3` or `iofog.org/v3` as `apiVersion`. Build-time flavor selects which apiVersion appears in doc examples (`datasance` vs `iofog` distribution builds). Registry paths and CLI name also vary by flavor.

## Core concepts

- **Edge computing**: Distributed computation and data storage close to data sources.
- **EdgeOps**: DevOps for the edge.
- **Microservices**: Deploy and manage container microservices at Edgelet nodes.
- **potctl**: Command-line interface for managing Datasance PoT.
- **Edgelet node**: Current v3.8 node runtime (YAML kind remains `Agent`).

## API

Datasance PoT Controller provides a REST API for controlling the platform.

- [Controller REST API (OpenAPI)](https://docs.datasance.com/api/controller): Interactive Controller API docs (v3.8.0).
- [Edgelet API (OpenAPI)](https://docs.datasance.com/api/edgelet): Interactive EdgeletAPI docs (v1.0.0).

## Legacy documentation snapshot

- [v3.7.3 docs snapshot](https://docs.datasance.com/v3.7.3/): Frozen legacy docs (Java Agent, ECN Viewer, Keycloak-first deployment). Not current for v3.8.0.
